verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Rollbar serves an llms.txt at docs.rollbar.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a Rollbar Docs index. A downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 file linked from docs.rollbar.com/openapi gives agents machine-readable API docs, and doc pages are available as .md variants. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the llms.txt or agent-oriented docs and how to use them, evidence of an llms-full.txt or full-content variant, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: HTTP 200 at https://docs.rollbar.com/llms.txt # Rollbar Docs Documentation
docs.rollbar.com/openapi ("All OpenAPI Files") links this downloadable machine-readable document
